items.name: utils
items.title: cn utility
items.description: The `cn` class-merge helper (clsx + tailwind-merge) that every @zeroxsolutions/ui component imports through the @/lib/utils alias.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The Button primitive - a Base UI button with class-variance-authority variants (default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive, link) and sizes.

items.name: button-hero
items.title: Button Hero
items.description: All Button variants in one row - the hero preview for the Button doc page.

items.name: button-default
items.title: Button Default
items.description: The default Button variant.

items.name: button-secondary
items.title: Button Secondary
items.description: The secondary Button variant.

items.name: button-outline
items.title: Button Outline
items.description: The outline Button variant.

items.name: button-destructive
items.title: Button Destructive
items.description: The destructive Button variant.

items.name: button-ghost
items.title: Button Ghost
items.description: The ghost Button variant.

items.name: model-info-card
items.title: Model Info Card
items.description: A composed model detail panel - an identity header (media slot, name over vendor, mono modelId) over titled ModelInfoCardSection bodies. Composes the cn utility.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: A single divided control - a primary action segment plus a caret that opens a menu of related variants. Composes ButtonGroup for the seamed outline; a matched variant/size is set per segment.

items.name: menu-button
items.title: Menu Button
items.description: A remembered-default split control - the primary repeats the currently-selected action and the caret opens a menu that changes which action is current. Composes ButtonGroup for the seamed outline.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: The wrapper for one chat message row, agnostic to how the body is rendered. User messages pin right as a bubble; assistant messages lay out as full-width prose with an optional agent identity row.

items.name: tree-item
items.title: Tree Item
items.description: One row of a hierarchy tree - the layer above TreeIndent. Owns the clickable name region, inline-rename, trailing actions, and an optional context menu.

items.name: field-group
items.title: Field Group
items.description: A field grid plus a fixed trailing action slot. Use it for any property row that mixes inputs with a side action - the slot is always reserved at one icon-button width so every row shares the same right edge.

items.name: ai-provider-picker
items.title: AI Provider Picker
items.description: A registry:block - a responsive grid of AiProviderCard tiles, each showing one AI provider via an AiProviderIcon in the card's icon slot. Composes the ai-provider-card and ai-provider-icon items into one reusable surface.

items.name: demo-page
items.title: Demo Page
items.description: A registry:page - a small page region composing the ai-provider-picker block and the chat-message component. Pages assemble blocks and components into a full interface region.

items.name: split-button-hero
items.title: SplitButton Hero
items.description: A divided control - a primary action segment plus a caret that opens a menu.

items.name: menu-button-hero
items.title: MenuButton Hero
items.description: A remembered-default split control - the primary repeats the selected action.

items.name: chat-message-hero
items.title: ChatMessage Hero
items.description: A user bubble plus an assistant row - monochrome.

items.name: tree-hero
items.title: TreeItem Hero
items.description: A small hierarchy tree of TreeItem rows.

items.name: field-group-hero
items.title: FieldGroup Hero
items.description: A two-column field grid with a trailing action slot.

items.name: ai-provider-picker-hero
items.title: AiProviderPicker Hero
items.description: The AiProviderPicker block rendering its default provider grid.

items.name: demo-page-hero
items.title: DemoPage Hero
items.description: The DemoPage region composing the picker block and chat component.
